comment: The maker's README names the Prob CV crossfade modes Normal (Linear), Biased (Quadratic) and Hard (Cubic); the menu the code builds prints Loose, Normal and Hard (src/Maestro.cpp:986-1002), and Normal is the default. The README also gives two Active output CV modes where the code has three (src/Maestro.cpp:1062-1080). The weight for a channel with nothing in its Prob CV jack is the knob alone, whatever the crossfade knob is set to (src/Maestro.cpp:412-421). An evaluation is scheduled and then carried out on the following sample, so a CV arriving with the clock is read after it has settled. The six channel inputs and outputs are given no family: the maker's own summary says they carry gate, clock, audio or trigger signals, so any colour would be a guess.
